snippet.title: Night Shift | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Night Shift now on Steam here: 

Congratulations, you got the job! Night shift at the 24/7 pizza parlor: Just go in for the shift, hand out pizzas to delivery people, throw out garbage and clean up the place for the morning. Oh, and don't stare at the ghost child. Or that other one.
